scope: Additive Inferno Tower normal/multi-target beam baseline and current TH18 Supercharge observations.
game_version: Official June 2018, September 2023, February and April 2026 Home Village notes, with current independent tables consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: June Balancing Changes
sources.limitations: Confirms the 10-tile multi-target range and unchanged 9-tile single-target range. It has no level table, lock/collision trace or deterministic target-order contract.

sources.title: More Balance Changes!
sources.limitations: Confirms historical first/maximum single-target DPS corrections through L8. It is not a current complete table or beam lifecycle contract.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms Inferno Tower level 12 is TH18 content, but publishes no exact value or beam lifecycle table.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
sources.limitations: Confirms two Inferno Tower Supercharges are available. Exact values and mechanics are not published in the note.

sources.title: Inferno Tower/Home Village
sources.limitations: Reports current L12, both TH18 Supercharge tables, two modes, the 1.5/5.25-second single-target stages, six-target multi mode, 0.128-second cadence and 128-second ammunition depletion. It has no immutable client build, beam trace, reload state or exact target/tick ordering.

sources.title: Inferno Tower
sources.limitations: Build-identified secondary table corroborates normal L1-L12 HP, initial DPS, costs, duration, TH requirements, 2x2 geometry and ground/air targeting; it does not publish Supercharge values or a deterministic beam trace.

sources.title: Inferno Tower Single
sources.limitations: Independently corroborates L12 and Supercharge HP, the 165/350/3,500 single-target stages, 9 tiles, 0.128 seconds, cost and duration. It has no ammunition, collision or target-order trace.

sources.title: Inferno Tower Multi
sources.limitations: Independently corroborates L12 and Supercharge HP, 165 multi-target DPS, six targets, 0.128 seconds, cost and duration. Its displayed 9-tile range conflicts with Supercell's documented 10-tile multi mode and is not imported over the primary range evidence.

sources.title: Inferno Tower payload
sources.limitations: Pins normal levels, normal/multi per-impact values and cadence. It does not include the current Supercharge rows or a reproducible attack lifecycle.

support.note: Core serializes selected normal or multi_target mode before battle, a direct beam and the source-backed normal-mode lock timer. Headless, Viewer and RL consume the same logical state; client beam acquisition/collision and persistent ammunition/reload stay partial.

value.core_boundary: Fresh battle scenarios use the sourced armed combat values. Core serializes lock elapsed time and target identity, but does not model village-persistent depletion or reloading and does not invent a mid-battle reload or mode transition.

partial_mechanics_contract.note: Current secondary mechanics table; primary range evidence prevails over the multi-page's conflicting displayed 9-tile value.

known_uncertainties: The current exact Supercharge values and beam stages are secondary, although two independent current tables agree and the official April note confirms the two charges.
No consulted public source supplies a reproducible beam acquisition, target-loss, collision, target-tie or same-tick ordering trace.
Ammunition depletion and out-of-battle reload are described, but the serialized village depletion state and any mid-battle reload lifecycle are not published.
No source-verified current Supercharge sprite asset is available; Viewer exposes Core's supercharged state without claiming an exact special visual.
conclusion: Inferno Tower L1-L12 and TH18 Supercharge L1-L2 have a shared-Core normal/multi-target direct-beam baseline with serialized lock state, mode persistence and current additive Supercharge values; client beam selection, collision, timing order, persistent ammunition and exact visual fidelity remain partial.
